description: This file contains shell functions related to network interface configuration in the OpenWrt system, including functions to find configurations, perform ubus calls, fix up interface configurations, and setup interfaces.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds the network interface configuration matching a specific device name.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call and loads the JSON response.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts the interface configuration, setting the appropriate interface name based on its type.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configurations and applies fixup to each interface.

methods.name: prepare_interface_bridge
methods.description: Prepares a bridge interface via ubus call.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface via ubus.

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Sets sysctl parameters if a value is provided, or retrieves the current value.
